name: ml-pipeline
description: Machine learning pipeline with feature engineering, model training, and evaluation
constitution_principles: Production code must not depend on notebooks; notebooks remain exploratory and import from src, never the other way around.
Raw data is immutable after ingest, and domain modules remain free of ML and dataframe framework imports.

starter_rules.prevents: production dependencies on exploratory notebook code
triggers: src file imports notebooks package or notebook-relative path
pipeline implementation moves reusable logic into notebooks instead of src
starter_rules.rule: Keep notebooks exploratory only. Production code under `src/` must never import from `notebooks/`.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review imports in `src/` for `notebooks` package references or relative imports that traverse into `notebooks/`.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Shared logic lives under `src/`; notebooks may import from `src/` for analysis, but production code does not depend on notebooks.

starter_rules.prevents: mutation of raw datasets and loss of data lineage
triggers: pipeline design writes transformed output back into raw dataset locations
starter_rules.rule: Treat `data/raw/` as immutable after ingest. Derived artifacts belong under `data/processed/` or another explicitly versioned output location.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Block edits to files under `data/raw/` unless the team is performing a one-time ingest/bootstrap outside the governed application flow.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Ingest once into `data/raw/`, then write all derived or transformed artifacts into `data/processed/` or a managed artifact store.
